entries.085a3a93982a3d03: As a medium-sized logistics company, it sets out a basic policy of aiming to be a company that provides services suited to customer needs while drawing on its own features, and in which employees can work safely and energetically. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it lists enhancing its community-based strategy, proposing and implementing integrated logistics systems such as logistics center operations, promoting combined and joint logistics, promoting procurement logistics, temperature-zone logistics and industrial waste recycling businesses, expanding special technical services such as moving and the installation of machinery and fixtures, widening its area and developing new services through alliances, and promoting safety and environmental conservation activities.

entries.2f3570f3047ce3ae: Taiho Transportation is a logistics company with its head office in Naka-ku, Nagoya. It was established in 1951 as Chuo Kyuhai, does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the number of employees is 681 (as of March 20, 2026).

In addition, it runs an insurance agency business, and carries out solar power generation business at the Miyoshi Branch.

entries.63446b66c17ea835: A business that holds a general motor truck transportation business permit under the Motor Truck Transportation Business Act and transports mainly consumer-related cargo such as foodstuffs and daily necessities in its operating areas of Aichi, Gifu, Mie and Shizuoka Prefectures. It also holds permits for first-class and second-class freight forwarding business under the Freight Forwarding Business Act. It has 9 branches in Aichi Prefecture and 1 branch in Mie Prefecture, and provides transportation services as part of comprehensive logistics services together with its warehouse business.
